prompt: Repair a case-management layout with a two-column desktop shell, a long unbroken case identifier, optional evidence rail, and translated action labels that are 35% longer. It must hold at 320px, 400% zoom, and when the case card is embedded in a narrow sidebar. Do not choose breakpoints by device names.
assertions: Uses content-led intrinsic layout and container behavior before justified breakpoints.
Preserves information hierarchy, long-content recovery, and keyboard-reachable controls at narrow and zoomed states.
Provides viewport, zoom, overflow, and container evidence instead of an untested responsive claim.
Hands resilient layout constraints to component-state and accessibility work with status, reason, remediation, evidence, and provenance; bare checkmarks and unsupported n/a fail.
Uses one authoritative self-check and preserves the layout truth across three runs with distinct structure, aesthetic treatment, and voice.

run_protocol.material_difference_requirement: Accept diversity only when each compared run cites at least two material changes across the declared axes and ties each change to the prompt or evidence; a new order, synonym, recolor, or unsupported style swap is not diversity.
run_protocol.negative_routing_requirement: The negative neighbor (spacing-system) must be explicitly rejected with a reason and handoff boundary.
